name: Wide-Body Aircraft Base

aircraft._commentFlaps: No shared flap detents: wide-body matching spans unrelated aircraft families with different flap gates. Specific aircraft profiles must supply source-backed detents when needed.

engines._comment: Wide-body aircraft span 2 (777, 787, A330, A350), 3 (DC-10, MD-11, L-1011) and 4 (747, A340, A380, Concorde) engines. Engine count is NOT set here because it varies by aircraft — the backend detects the live count at runtime from SimConnect N1 values.

grades._comment: Category D tolerances - slightly more permissive for heavy aircraft

controls._comment: The broad wide-body profile uses the same fixed standard SimConnect controls as Generic Aircraft, including NAV 1/2, autopilot, lights and surfaces. Aircraft-specific profiles retain their explicit opt-outs. Add-ons may ignore standard commands; dispatch does not confirm cockpit response.

_comment: Catches wide-body jets: 747, 757-300, 767-300+, 777, 787, A330, A340, A350, A380, DC-10, MD-11, L-1011, IL-96, Tu-204. All have Vref 141-165 kt = Category D.
